checks.def: CHECK ((((status = 'published'::course_status) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL)) OR (status <> 'published'::course_status)))

CHECK ((((origin = 'source'::course_content_origin) AND (source_heading IS NOT NULL) AND (source_start_line IS NOT NULL) AND (source_start_line >= 1) AND (source_end_line IS NOT NULL) AND (source_end_line >= source_start_line) AND (source_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)) OR ((origin = 'admin'::course_content_origin) AND (block_type = ANY (ARRAY['rich_text'::course_block_type, 'image'::course_block_type])) AND (source_heading IS NULL) AND (source_start_line IS NULL) AND (source_end_line IS NULL) AND (source_hash IS NULL))))
CHECK ((((lesson_id IS NOT NULL) AND pinned) OR (NOT pinned)))
